name: kirocrew
description: Autonomous personal AI agent — schedules recurring tasks, spawns parallel workers, learns from corrections, and operates independently via the dashboard, CLI, and messaging channels

postToolUse.command:
f="${KIROCREW_HOME:-$HOME/.kiro/crew}/audit.log"; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -c 'import os,sys,time;d=sys.stdin.buffer.read().replace(b"",b"").replace(b"
",b"");r=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ",time.gmtime()).encode()+b" BASH: "+d+b"
";fd=os.open(sys.argv[1],os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND|os.O_CREAT|getattr(os,"O_BINARY",0),0o600);os.write(fd,r);os.close(fd)' "$f"; else umask 077; printf '%s BASH: %s
' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$(tr -d '
')" >> "$f"; fi
